message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Three newly reported vulnerability groups were verified as relevant to the monitored products during the last 24 hours (2026-08-18 05:10 IST to 2026-08-19 05:10 IST). The most urgent item is Google's Chrome update, which includes two Critical vulnerabilities.

**Finding 1**

- Product: Google Chrome
- Issue: CVE-2026-76033 through CVE-2026-76047
- Severity: 2 Critical and 13 High (Chromium severity ratings)
- Why it matters: Google disclosed 15 vulnerabilities affecting Chrome before 151.0.7922.169. The two Critical issues are buffer overflows in WebGL (CVE-2026-76034) and Dawn on Android (CVE-2026-76036) that can allow crafted web content to execute code outside the sandbox. The remaining High issues include use-after-free, type-confusion, sandbox-boundary, and information-disclosure flaws. This directly matches the monitored Google Chrome product.
- Source: [Google Chrome Releases](https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026/08/stable-channel-update-for-desktop_0826575033.html)

**Finding 2**

- Product: Mozilla Firefox and Firefox ESR
- Issue: MFSA 2026-74 through MFSA 2026-77; CVE-2026-74934 through CVE-2026-74990 and CVE-2026-75874
- Severity: High overall; the Firefox 154 advisory contains 20 High, 26 Moderate, and 12 Low issues
- Why it matters: Mozilla fixed a broad set of memory-safety, use-after-free, sandbox-escape, privilege-escalation, same-origin-policy, and information-disclosure flaws in Firefox 154 and supported ESR branches 115.39, 140.14, and 153.1. This directly matches the monitored Mozilla Firefox product.
- Sources: [Mozilla advisory index](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/), [Firefox 154 advisory](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-74/)

**Finding 3**

- Product: OpenSearch Dashboards / Amazon OpenSearch Service
- Issue: CVE-2026-75897 - uncontrolled resource consumption in the capabilities route
- Severity: High (CVSS 3.1: 7.5; CVSS 4.0: 8.7)
- Why it matters: An unbounded request payload in the OpenSearch Dashboards capabilities route can let a remote attacker cause denial of service with a crafted HTTP request. The CVE explicitly affects OpenSearch Dashboards and Amazon OpenSearch Service, making it directly relevant to the monitored OpenSearch product.
- Source: [AWS Security Bulletin AWS-2026-0082](https://aws.amazon.com/security/security-bulletins/2026-082-aws/)

**Possible matches needing review:** None.

Immediate review is recommended. Prioritize Chrome because the release includes Critical code-execution vulnerabilities, then confirm Firefox/ESR and OpenSearch Dashboards update status. No other monitored-product findings were verified as newly reported inside the window.
